draft_en.subject: Media converters for the Cellco fibre range - STI-110GE from small lots
draft_en.body:
Hi Tomasz,

Some time ago you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 1 September - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is about the part of your range we actually fit: media converters.

Alongside Cellco's fibre cabling, CWDM and FTTH lines, we supply industrial-grade gigabit media converters, neutral-brand or your label, from small lots:

- 1 x Gigabit RJ45 + 1 x SFP, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity).
- Same unit with PoE+ output on the copper port, model STI-111GP - $27.8 USD EXW.
- Companion 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP industrial switch, unmanaged, model STI-280GE - $46.6 USD EXW.

CE/RoHS; metal housing; 3-year warranty with our DIN power supply. Optics, patch cords and CWDM stay with your existing suppliers - we only do the active boxes.

One question: which converter type do your FTTH and enterprise customers buy most - plain gigabit, or the PoE version?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
